data.title: Tether Says It Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Showed. What Does That Mean for BTC?
data.description: Tether's CEO just revealed a Bitcoin stockpile far larger than any official reserve report has shown, raising questions about what the stablecoin giant is actually building and whether its public disclosures tell the whole story.
